pose: TALL_MEASURE framing. The Wukongopterus stands erect on a volcanic outcropping. It displays a unique transitional anatomy with its long tail extending to the bottom margin and its pterodactyloid-style head reaching the very top. The pose is tall and alert.

environmental_details.ground: Dark grey shale with visible volcanic ash layers.
environmental_details.flora: Distant cycads and conifers under a hazy Jurassic sky.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Atmospheric woodland mist providing depth to the vertical shot.
